changelog: Fixed ELF syntax error and bash execution failure on 32-bit ARM devices (Realme C63, etc.)
Added automatic architecture-aware bootstrap selection (official bootstrap-arm.zip for 32-bit devices)
Added dual Go bridge compilation for both 32-bit ARM (GOARM=7) and 64-bit ARM64
Fixed symlink target rewriting from /data/data/com.termux/files to dynamic app sandbox path
Ensured safe fallback mirrors and robust integrity verification across all CPU architectures
